1_pb_pid_exists_removed.finding: R17 pb_pid_exists() matched localized kill -0 stderr text (English strings for EPERM/ESRCH). This is unreliable across OS, shell, and locale; EPERM vs ESRCH inference from human-readable output violates Finding 2.
1_pb_pid_exists_removed.fix: pb_pid_exists() removed entirely from §5. Shutdown design replaced with watchdog pattern that uses ps -o ppid= (structured output, no localized text) for ownership verification.

2_watchdog_termination_pattern.finding: R17 polled kill -0 before calling wait. A zombie child (exited but not yet reaped) satisfies kill -0, causing false SIGKILL escalation and spurious CLEANUP_FAILURE.
2_watchdog_termination_pattern.fix: New pb_trap_cleanup() order: (1) PPID verified with ps -o ppid= — process confirmed as our direct child; (2) SIGTERM sent; (3) background watchdog subshell sleeps 6s then re-verifies PPID before sending SIGKILL; writes a flag file if it fires; (4) wait called in parent — reaps normal exit and zombie immediately without delay; (5) watchdog cancelled (kill) and reaped (wait || true); (6) result classified by flag file and wait rc; (7) PPID re-checked after wait; (8) CLEANUP_FAILURE=1 only for genuine escalation or confirmed-unreaped child; (9) PID cleared.

3_or_true_inventory_updated.r18_site_2: wait '$_watchdog_pid' 2>/dev/null || true in pb_trap_cleanup — BENIGN: wait returns nonzero when watchdog was killed by cancel signal; replaces old 'wait $_stored_pid || true' site which is now clean (rc captured).

4_selftest_updated.added: ps -o ppid= check for PID 99999999: verifies a non-existent PID does not appear to belong to this process (structured, no text parsing)

5_concurrency_auth_helper_exit_status.finding: R17 called python3 pbj_http.py then immediately read output files without capturing or checking the helper's exit status.
5_concurrency_auth_helper_exit_status.fix: In t_concurrency_auth_group(), _helper_rc captured immediately after pbj_http.py invocation for the pre-worker record fetch. If _helper_rc != 0: t_harness_err emitted, allocated files removed, function returns 1 without parsing status or response path.

6_concurrency_otp_send_redesigned.finding: R17 T-CONCURRENCY-OTP-SEND targeted /api/collections/users/request-otp with email identity and Mailhog delivery — PocketBase email OTP, not Release 1B phone/WhatsApp OTP. No probe should send a real OTP request. Rate-limit invariant was undefined (broad 200/204/429 accepted set). Per-worker auth config was missing.
6_concurrency_otp_send_redesigned.fix: T-CONCURRENCY-OTP-SEND completely redesigned. Immediately checks HOOK_OTP_PHONE_ROUTE and HOOK_OTP_MOCK_CONTROL_ROUTE constants. If either is UNRESOLVED__NEEDS_EXTERNAL (current state), emits MANDATORY-DEFERRED listing all six prerequisite categories. No HTTP request of any kind is made. Mailhog not referenced. Implementation deferred until endpoint contract is supplied.

7_hook_otp_constants_added.description: HOOK_OTP_PHONE_ROUTE and HOOK_OTP_MOCK_CONTROL_ROUTE added to §3 CONSTANTS as UNRESOLVED__NEEDS_EXTERNAL__ placeholders. Referenced by T-CONCURRENCY-OTP-SEND and pb_check_package_completeness().

8_idempotency_wording_updated.description: t_concurrency_idempotency_post_group() comment updated to explicitly state: T-CONCURRENCY-AUTH is IMPL; T-CONCURRENCY-OTP-SEND is MANDATORY-DEFERRED pending phone-OTP hook semantics; T-CONCURRENCY-IDEMPOTENCY-POST is MANDATORY-DEFERRED and implementation is INCOMPLETE (not merely deferred-because-configured).
